record.context_brief: Embedding matrix amplifications into matrix ultraproducts
record.original_question: For an arbitrary II_1 factor M, does M_2(C) ⊗ M always embed into the tracial matrix ultraproduct M_U = ∏_{n→U} M_n(C)?

evidence.quote: Problem 42. If M is a II1 factor, then does M2(C) ⊗ M always embed into MU? (Note this is immediate if M is Connes embeddable.)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{U}$ be a free ultrafilter on $\mathbb{N}$, and let $M_n(\mathbb{C})$ denote the algebra of $n\times n$ complex matrices equipped with its normalized trace $\mathrm{tr}_n$. Form the tracial matrix ultraproduct
$$\mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{U}} := \prod_{n\to\mathcal{U}} M_n(\mathbb{C}),$$
i.e., the quotient of $\ell^\infty(\mathbb{N},(M_n(\mathbb{C}),\mathrm{tr}_n))$ by the two-sided ideal of sequences $(x_n)$ with $\lim_{n\to\mathcal{U}}\mathrm{tr}_n(x_n^*x_n)=0$; this is a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor with trace $\tau((x_n)_{\mathcal{U}})=\lim_{n\to\mathcal{U}}\mathrm{tr}_n(x_n)$.

Recall that a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor $M$ is called Connes-embeddable if there exists a trace-preserving $*$-embedding $M\hookrightarrow \mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{U}}$ (equivalently, into an ultrapower of the hyperfinite $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor). It is known that the Connes embedding property fails for some $\mathrm{II}_1$ factors.

Question: For every $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor $M$ (with separable predual, equipped with its unique faithful normal tracial state), does there exist a trace-preserving unital $*$-embedding
$$M_2(\mathbb{C})\otimes M \;\hookrightarrow\; \mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{U}}\,?$$

(Note that if $M$ itself is Connes-embeddable, then so is $M_2(\mathbb{C})\otimes M$, and the embedding is automatic.)
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in a 2025 collection of 50 open problems on ultraproduct II_1 factors. While the Connes embedding problem itself has been resolved negatively (MIP*=RE, 2020), this weaker matrix-amplification variant — whether $M_2(\mathbb{C})\otimes M$ always embeds into the matrix ultraproduct — does not appear to be settled in the literature; web searches turn up no resolution.

status_evidence.title: The Connes embedding problem: A guided tour
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of the Connes embedding problem and its negative resolution via MIP*=RE; does not address the matrix-amplification variant.
status_evidence.claim: The full Connes embedding problem is resolved negatively, but the M_2(C)⊗M variant is not discussed as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Model theory and ultrapower embedding problems in operator algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses post-CEP embedding questions for II_1 factors into matrix ultraproducts.
status_evidence.claim: Embedding questions for non-Connes-embeddable factors into matrix ultraproducts remain active and open.
